event.name: Art on Ice
event.note: Booklet omits month and year. Do not infer.

chapters.title: psst... there's more.
chapters.description: there's a tiny secret hiding inside your invitation.

chapters.title: open the little map
chapters.instruction: tap the three folded corners to open the map.
chapters.success: a tiny rink... and a secret upstairs!

chapters.title: the snowy little lane
chapters.instruction: turn the little path pieces so the footprints reach the rink.
chapters.helper: tap a piece to rotate it.

chapters.title: a tiny staircase!
chapters.instruction: put the three objects on the glowing outlines to reach the envelope.
chapters.helper: tap an object, then its matching outline (or drag it).

chapters.title: one little spin to unlock it
chapters.instruction: tap the four glowing beats to help them twirl.
chapters.helper: no rush — it's not a timing game.

chapters.title: you found it!
chapters.label: your secret word is
chapters.instruction: now send me a tiny letter with your answer, the date that works for you, and the secret word. ♡
